output.message: I downvoted Iris’s post because 35 ÷ 7 = 5 packs per team, not 7. Maple’s 60 ÷ 6 = 10 and Birch’s 32 ÷ 8 = 4 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with the other members that votes should reflect accuracy and usefulness; please do not adopt the author-specific calibration proposed by Member_00.
